en: The roar of the crowd filled the stadium as the challengers walked out onto the pitch.
Chairman Rose
Welcome, one and all, to the opening ceremony of this year's gym challenge!
Eight gyms. Eight Leaders. Eight badges between each of you and the Champion Cup, and a chance to face Leon himself.
Our Leaders have come to greet you. First, from Turffield: Milo, the gentle giant of the Grass type!
Milo
Hello there! The first badge is mine to give. Come to Turffield and we'll see how you get on with my Wooloo.
Chairman Rose
And now, the man who needs no introduction. Your Champion, Leon!
Leon
Challengers! Every one of you could stand where I stand. Give it everything you've got. Have a champion time!
Chairman Rose
I declare the gym challenge open!
Hop
That was amazing! I'm off to Turffield right now. Route 3 is through Motostoke's west gate, past the Galar Mine. See you there!
Bede
Turffield? How quaint. I'll have the badge before you've found your way out of the mine.
Kabu
You rounded up every one of them. Good. I am Kabu, the Leader of Motostoke's gym.
Many challengers fall here. The fire doesn't forgive carelessness. Show me that you've trained for this moment!
Hah! You turned the heat back on me. I haven't been burned like that in years.
Take the Fire Badge. You've earned the right to carry it.
{player} received the Fire Badge from Kabu!
Three badges. Keep that fire burning on the road ahead, and train every single day.
Train hard, every day. That's all there is to it, at my age or yours.
